Should Canada Join the USA?

Maybe not as 10 new states, but perhaps as a semi-autonomous region, somewhat like how European countries maintain their own governments and institutions but within the EU framework.

Canada and the USA are the most developed countries in North America. We share basically the same culture, the same stores and music and movies and mostly the same language (Quebec aside). Go to any mid-sized American or Canadian city and you would be hard-pressed to find a difference.

Both nations have a vested interest in the security of the continent and both countries are constantly trying to align economic policy so the $1 billion per day in trade isn't interrupted.

Canadian and American people are, regardless of ethnic heritage, largely compassionate and accepting of each other and we have more in common than we do differences.

Most of the political and economic power would obviously be based in the US portion of the Union, but it already is anyways so that wouldn't make much of a difference. Instead our two countries could become two-nations-in-one-country...or even three-in-one if Quebec is given autonomy as well. A big powerful country called the American Union or some such name.

For instance, a shared currency, open borders and one unified economic and trade policy could offer immense benefits to both countries. An American currency and American passports would mean uninterrupted trade and travel between the two. Americans would benefit from Canadian resources and Canadians would benefit from access to American markets and fairer pricing and taxation.

Just a query out of curiosity. BTW I'm Canadian and I love the US as well. I've travelled the world and I find the North American continent to be the most beautiful and amazing of them all. I find Americans to generally be warm, intelligent and friendly people and see no differences between the people of both countries.
